title: SH-PDOPS: AI-Driven Cloud Native Enterprise Reliability Framework for Predictive Analytics and Intelligent DevOps Automation
abstract: arXiv:2609.04210v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents an AI-driven cloud-native enterprise reliability framework designed to improve predictive analytics, intelligent DevOps automation, and system resilience in modern distributed infrastructures. The proposed framework integrates machine learning models, Kubernetes orchestration, observability pipelines, and automated incident response mechanisms to enhance reliability engineering practices. The study explores predictive failure detection, anomaly monitoring, self-healing infrastructure, and CI/CD optimization using cloud-native technologies. Experimental evaluation demonstrates improved operational efficiency, reduced downtime, and enhanced scalability for enterprise environments. The framework provides a practical approach for combining artificial intelligence with DevOps methodologies to achieve adaptive and autonomous infrastructure management.

translated_title: SH-PDOPS：面向预测分析与智能DevOps自动化的AI驱动云原生企业可靠性框架
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种AI驱动的云原生企业可靠性框架，旨在改善现代分布式基础设施中的预测分析、智能DevOps自动化和系统弹性。该框架集成了机器学习模型、Kubernetes编排、可观测性流水线和自动化事件响应机制，以增强可靠性工程实践。该研究探索了利用云原生技术实现的预测性故障检测、异常监控、自愈基础设施和CI/CD优化。实验评估表明，该框架提高了企业环境的运营效率，减少了停机时间，并增强了可扩展性。该框架为将人工智能与DevOps方法论相结合以实现自适应和自主的基础设施管理提供了一种实用方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种AI驱动的云原生企业可靠性框架SH-PDOPS，通过整合机器学习模型、Kubernetes编排和自动化事件响应机制，实现预测性故障检测、自愈基础设施和智能DevOps自动化，从而提升运营效率、减少停机时间并增强系统可扩展性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SH-PDOPS, an AI-driven cloud-native enterprise reliability framework that integrates machine learning models, Kubernetes orchestration, and automated incident response mechanisms to achieve predictive failure detection, self-healing infrastructure, and intelligent DevOps automation, improving operational efficiency, reducing downtime, and enhancing scalability.
